core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gafoor corresponds to the Arabic form غفور (Arabic root غ ف ر (gh-f-r); غَفور (Ghafūr)). Its core sense is forgiving, most generous. Gafoor is a South Asian spelling of Arabic غفور (Ghafūr) 'most forgiving', an intensive adjective from the root غ ف ر (gh-f-r) and a divine name in Islamic tradition.
